# Rules

Rules provide system-level instructions to Agent.

### Project Rules

Stored in `.cursor/rules`, version-controlled and scoped to your codebase.

### AGENTS.md

Agent instructions in markdown format. Simple alternative to `.cursor/rules`.

## Project rules

Project rules live in `.cursor/rules` as `.mdc` files and are version-controlled. A plain `.md` file in `.cursor/rules` is ignored.

### Creating a rule

There are two ways to create rules.

Type `/create-rule` in Agent and describe what you want.

## Best practices

Good rules are focused, actionable, and scoped.

### What to avoid in rules

Copying entire style guides: use a linter instead.

## Team Rules

Team Rules take precedence: Team Rules then Project Rules then User Rules.

## AGENTS.md

`AGENTS.md` is a simple markdown file for defining agent instructions.

Why isn't my rule being applied?
